==Purpose of template==

Link to a specific {{Link|https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php|Theoryland Interview Database}} interview or question.

==How to use==

<pre>{{tidb|interview number}}
{{tidb|interview number|question number}}
{{tidb|interview number|question number|interview title}}
{{tidb|interview number||interview title}}</pre>

==Examples==

<pre>{{tidb|180}}</pre>
{{tidb|180}}

<pre>{{tidb|828|1}}</pre>
{{tidb|828|1}}

<pre>{{tidb|828|1|TEOTW Signing Report - The Fisher King}}</pre>
{{tidb|828|1|TEOTW Signing Report - The Fisher King}}

<pre>{{tidb|828||TEOTW Signing Report - The Fisher King}}</pre>
{{tidb|828||TEOTW Signing Report - The Fisher King}}

<pre>{{tidb|180|6}}</pre>
{{tidb|180|6}}
